name: CML Migrations
description: Import side of a CommerceML (1C) exchange: consumes cmlapi's parsed data through Migrate to create Commerce products, variations, catalog taxonomy, warehouse-stock and price paragraphs; run via a drush-driven pipeline.
project_description: Import side of a CommerceML / 1C:Enterprise (and МойСклад / MoySklad) exchange for Drupal Commerce. The sibling module cmlapi receives and parses the exchange XML; CML Migrations consumes those parsed arrays through the Migrate framework (migrate_plus + migrate_tools) and writes them into commerce_product, commerce_product_variation and catalog taxonomy terms. Variations are linked to their product by a 1C UUID base field (product_uuid); per-warehouse stock and multiple price types are optionally imported as paragraphs. Migrations are orchestrated out of process (drush mim --group=cml via shell_exec, optionally nohup) with a cml entity state machine and a cron watchdog. The 2.x major requires Drupal 11/12 and refactors the migration source plugins onto a typed service-container helper. Configured at admin/structure/migrate/cmlmigrations; all admin pages require 'administer site configuration'.
